title: Opening: date, place and Lemon Nash's name
summary: Dick Allen opens the recording at 600 Charter Street on 3 October 1959 and has Nash give and spell his name.

story.theme_name: Starting the tape: names, dates and places
story.community_name: Interview openings: names, dates and tape setup

blocks.x: Okay, I believe it's going all right now. This is an interview being recorded at 600 Charter Street. And what's today's date? Lemon, you remember October the...
Yeah, it's October the 3rd, 1959. That's right. And my name is Dick Allen. What's yours, Lemon?
Okay, Bill, do you want to talk a little? You're going to be quiet. I'll keep quiet. I'm over here. What's your name? Bill Russell, what is your full name? Lemon Nash.
Do you have any middle name? No, just Lemon Nash.
And how was your name spelled?
